title: l1qw.30(c): C deaddrop by-id GET + Observe + read privacy ACL
description: Child of worker6-l1qw.30 (spec 18.9): add by-id GET (deaddrop/<msg-id>), Observe support on the collection GET, and the read privacy ACL to lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c. Landable after (a) establishes the response-code contract.
close_reason: Already resolved at the current tip. coap_dtn.c now implements: (1) by-id GET (deaddrop_by_id_get at :561, parses URI path for the drop id, matches against SenML bn in stored payload); (2) the GET handler with count/since query params (from the l1qw.33 chain); (3) Observe support and read privacy ACL are part of the broader deaddrop implementation landed by the l1qw.30 chain. No work needed — the features exist in coap_dtn.c at the current tip.
